<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-1816-40-00" status="unreviewed">yang <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha 1</rs> na re gzung yul dang 'jug yul gyi sgo ldog gtang snyoms su gzhag nas spyir yul bden ldan tsam 1u ma 'khrul ba'i don ldog du byed de | de spyar na rjes dpag la yang mngon sum gyi ma 'khrul ba tshang bar thal spyir yul bden ldan tcsi yod pa'i phyir | yang bla ma kha te na re dgag bya 'khrul pa ngos 'dzin
               <lb n="N008"/>tsam na 'dzin stangs rang gis sgor btags par rig pa la byed pas ma 'khrul ba yang 'dzin stangs rang gis sgro ma btags par rig pa yin gsung | 'di mi rigs te de ltar na byas pas sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag de la 'jug yul phyi rol la ltos nas mngon suM spyi ma 'khrul pa tshang bar tha pa 'dzin stangs rang gis sgro ma btags pa rig pa yod pa'i
               <lb n="N009"/>phyir | des na ma 'khrul pa'i don ni rang ldog la 'khrul pa'i mtshan nyid ma rten pa yin rjes dpag la yang gzung yul la ltos nas 'khrul pa'i mtshid rten pas khyab ches pa'i skyon med do |</seg></TEI>
